response.rationale: These look like two different concepts. Booking is a public session booking: RinkService creates it with BookingRepository.create and looks it up through BookingRepository.listBySession and get. Club Booking is a separate entity in its own repository, ClubBookingRepository, which uses Map<string, ClubBooking>. ClubService manages it through book, invoice, getRate and setRate, so it is a club reservation that gets invoiced and has its own rates. RinkService reads club bookings only in effectiveCapacity, through ClubBookingRepository.listByDate. That suggests club bookings are a different kind of reservation that uses up rink capacity, not the same thing as a session booking. The fact that both are bookings isn't enough to treat them as one concept.
